entries.title: Galatians 4:1
segments: ¶Now I say [that] the heir, as long as he is a child, does not differ at all from a slave, though he is master of all,

entries.title: Galatians 4:2
segments: but is under guardians and stewards until the time appointed by the father.

entries.title: Galatians 4:3
segments: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world.

entries.title: Galatians 4:4
segments: But when the fullness of the time had come, God sent forth His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

entries.title: Galatians 4:5
segments: to redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as sons.

entries.title: Galatians 4:6
segments: And because you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying out, "Abba, Father!"

entries.title: Galatians 4:7
segments: Therefore you are no longer a slave but a son, and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 4:8
segments: ¶But then, indeed, when you did not know God, you served those which by nature are not gods.

entries.title: Galatians 4:9
segments: But now after you have known God, or rather are known by God, how [is it that] you turn again to the weak and beggarly elements, to which you desire again to be in bondage?

entries.title: Galatians 4:10
segments: You observe days and months and seasons and years.

entries.title: Galatians 4:11
segments: I am afraid for you, lest I have labored for you in vain.

entries.title: Galatians 4:12
segments: ¶Brethren, I urge you to become like me, for I [became] like you. You have not injured me at all.

entries.title: Galatians 4:13
segments: You know that because of physical infirmity I preached the gospel to you at the first.

entries.title: Galatians 4:14
segments: And my trial which was in my flesh you did not despise or reject, but you received me as an angel of God, [even] as Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Galatians 4:15
segments: What then was the blessing you [enjoyed]? For I bear you witness that, if possible, you would have plucked out your own eyes and given them to me.

entries.title: Galatians 4:16
segments: Have I therefore become your enemy because I tell you the truth?

entries.title: Galatians 4:17
segments: ¶They zealously court you, [but] for no good; yes, they want to exclude you, that you may be zealous for them.

entries.title: Galatians 4:18
segments: But it is good to be zealous in a good thing always, and not only when I am present with you.

entries.title: Galatians 4:19
segments: ¶My little children, for whom I labor in birth again until Christ is formed in you,

entries.title: Galatians 4:20
segments: I would like to be present with you now and to change my tone; for I have doubts about you.

entries.title: Galatians 4:21
segments: ¶Tell me, you who desire to be under the law, do you not hear the law?

entries.title: Galatians 4:22
segments: For it is written that Abraham had two sons: the one by a bondwoman, the other by a freewoman.

entries.title: Galatians 4:23
segments: But he [who was] of the bondwoman was born according to the flesh, and he of the freewoman through promise,

entries.title: Galatians 4:24
segments: which things are symbolic. For these are the two covenants: the one from Mount Sinai which gives birth to bondage, which is Hagar--

entries.title: Galatians 4:25
segments: for this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and corresponds to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children--

entries.title: Galatians 4:26
segments: but the Jerusalem above is free, which is the mother of us all.

entries.title: Galatians 4:27
segments: For it is written: "Rejoice, O barren, [You] who do not bear! Break forth and shout, You who are not in labor! For the desolate has many more children Than she who has a husband."

entries.title: Galatians 4:28
segments: Now we, brethren, as Isaac [was], are children of promise.

entries.title: Galatians 4:29
segments: But, as he who was born according to the flesh then persecuted him [who was born] according to the Spirit, even so [it is] now.

entries.title: Galatians 4:30
segments: Nevertheless what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the bondwoman and her son, for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman."

entries.title: Galatians 4:31
segments: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman but of the free.
